name: smwmusic-crash-nitro-kart-electron-avenue-magnetic-mayhem
title: Crash Nitro Kart - Electron Avenue / Magnetic Mayhem
description:
An upbeat techno theme that plays in Electron Avenue, the fan favorite track from Crash Nitro Kart which is set in a futuristic city at night. In CTR Nitro-Fueled, this track was massively revamped with a neon vaporwave-like aesthetic.

Also for some reason this song plays in Magnetic Mayhem, a battle arena based on Assembly Lane, which doesn't really fit.

You can define in the .txt file which variation you want to use:
0 - Default in-game version
1 - Extended OST version (3:14, 0x0AC0)

Note: The OST version of this song is incompatible with thunder, blargg and Yoshi sound effects and the vanilla bonus end jingle.
